About the job
Vennholm Packaging Group is a Scandinavian-German manufacturer of flexible and rigid packaging for food, pet food and personal care brands. With 5,600 employees in 23 plants and revenues of EUR 1.4 billion, we are one of the larger independent packaging producers in Europe.

In August 2026 we closed the acquisition of Mazovia Flexpak, a Polish producer of printed flexible packaging with three plants (Warsaw, Łódź and Poznań), 1,100 employees and revenues of around EUR 230 million. It is the largest integration in our history, and we want it led from where the business is.

We are therefore looking for an experienced Post-Merger Integration Lead to run our Integration Management Office in Warsaw for the next nine months.

Your role
- Set up and run the Integration Management Office (IMO), including governance, reporting cadence and a weekly integration steering committee chaired by the Group CFO
- Turn the 100-day plan into a full integration roadmap and keep eight workstreams on track: finance, HR, IT, procurement, commercial, operations, EHS and legal
- Own the synergy case (EUR 18 million run-rate by the end of 2028), set up synergy tracking and challenge workstream leads on delivery
- Prepare the migration of Mazovia Flexpak into our group reporting (IFRS, monthly close on working day 5) and the SAP S/4HANA rollout scheduled for 2027
- Drive the harmonisation of purchasing for films, inks and adhesives together with our Group Category Managers
- Support local leadership on organisational design, retention of key people and communication with employee representatives
- Make culture part of the plan: joint leadership workshops, a buddy programme between plants and regular town halls

What you bring
- 10+ years of professional experience, including at least three post-merger integrations in a lead role, ideally in manufacturing
- A strong grasp of finance: synergy valuation, IFRS reporting, working capital
- Experience in running multi-workstream programmes with senior stakeholders
- Fluent English; Polish is a strong advantage
- Ability to work on site in Warsaw from Monday to Thursday, with regular visits to Łódź and Poznań

Contract details
- Start: 2 November 2026
- Duration: 9 months, possible extension until the SAP rollout
- Day rate: EUR 1,100 to 1,250, B2B contract with our Polish entity (invoice plus VAT)
- On-site only: the IMO sits with the local management team in Warsaw, remote work is not possible for this role
- Accommodation in Warsaw is covered for the first three months for candidates relocating from abroad
